title: [Feature Request] Add an option to hide certain audio streams.
line: Applications in the Audio Volume widget's Applications tab can now be hidden from their ⋮ menu, and shown again from the widget's menu.
explanation: The applet always listed every non-virtual playback and recording stream, with no way to leave out ones the user never adjusts, such as an effects processor that is always running. Streams with a single output device didn't even have a ⋮ menu. Separately, libplasma's PlasmaExtras.MenuItem copied a hidden QAction's forced-disabled state back as an explicit setEnabled(false), so a menu action that started hidden stayed greyed out once it became visible. Each stream's menu (⋮ button or right-click) now ends with a checkable "Hide <application>" item; hidden applications are stored per widget in a new hiddenStreams config list (keyed by stream kind and application name), and a "Show hidden applications" toggle in the widget's ☰ menu, present only while something is hidden, brings them back dimmed so they can be unhidden. MenuItem no longer copies the action's visible/enabled state onto itself, since it already reads both from the action.

commits.message:
applet: allow hiding applications from the Applications tab

Streams that are always there but never need changing, like effect
processors, clutter the list. Each stream's menu now has a "Hide" item
that remembers the application, and the applet menu can show them again.

BUG: 523166

plasmaextracomponents: don't keep actions disabled after they become visible

QAction reports itself as disabled while hidden, and MenuItem copied it
back with setEnabled(), so an action that started hidden stayed greyed
out once shown. MenuItem reads both from its action, so stop copying.

CCBUG: 523166

patches.diff:
From d319e52dd89e68f2329f807228c7ea458d223fe3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 03:06:05 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plasmaextracomponents: don't keep actions disabled after they
 become visible

QAction reports itself as disabled while hidden, and MenuItem copied it
back with setEnabled(), so an action that started hidden stayed greyed
out once shown. MenuItem reads both from its action, so stop copying.

CCBUG: 523166
---
 src/declarativeimports/plasmaextracomponents/qmenuitem.cpp | 3 ---
 1 file changed, 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/declarativeimports/plasmaextracomponents/qmenuitem.cpp b/src/declarativeimports/plasmaextracomponents/qmenuitem.cpp
index 068f17199..db7c57920 100644
--- a/src/declarativeimports/plasmaextracomponents/qmenuitem.cpp
+++ b/src/declarativeimports/plasmaextracomponents/qmenuitem.cpp
@@ -40,9 +40,6 @@ void QMenuItem::setAction(QAction *a)
             m_action->setVisible(false);
         }
 
-        setVisible(m_action->isVisible());
-        setEnabled(m_action->isEnabled());
-
         connect(m_action, &QAction::changed, this, &QMenuItem::textChanged);
         connect(m_action, &QAction::checkableChanged, this, &QMenuItem::checkableChanged);
         connect(m_action, &QAction::enabledChanged, this, &QMenuItem::enabledChanged);
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: Applications tab with three streams; with one output device the streams have no ⋮ menu and right-click does nothing, so there is no way to hide one
Fix: every stream has a ⋮ menu; it ends with a checkable "Hide EasyEffects" item (below "Play audio using" when there are several devices)
Fix: while an application is hidden, the ☰ menu offers "Show hidden applications"
After choosing Hide EasyEffects: only Discord and Firefox are listed (still hidden after restarting plasmashell)
With "Show hidden applications" on, EasyEffects comes back dimmed and its menu shows Hide checked; unchecking it unhides it and the ☰ entry goes away
plasma-pa change without the old enabled workaround, on stock libplasma: after hiding the first application, "Show hidden applications" appears greyed out and can't be clicked
Same steps with the libplasma fix: "Show hidden applications" is enabled and works, with no workaround in plasma-pa

review.text: Hiding per application (stream kind + application.name) in the existing per-stream menu, with a 'Show hidden applications' toggle modelled on 'Show virtual devices', is a sensible and contained design, and the media show it working and persisting. The extra `enabled:` binding on the ☰ action works around a libplasma bug: PlasmaExtras.MenuItem/QMenuItem::setAction copies an initially hidden QAction's forced-disabled state back as setEnabled(false). That belongs in libplasma.
changes: Fix QMenuItem::setAction in libplasma so it does not persist the disabled state of an initially invisible QAction (separate MR), and drop the `enabled: main.hiddenStreams.length > 0` workaround from the plasma-pa action.
